data.title: Basic Example
data.description: An example mineproj site showcasing five personal projects.

items.title: Voxel Tool
items.content_text: A tiny voxel editor that runs entirely in the browser with zero install, built on WebGL and a custom greedy-meshing renderer for smooth 60fps edits.

items.title: Pixel Pong
items.content_text: A one-file pong clone with gamepad support and a CRT-style filter, written in vanilla JavaScript to prove how far a single HTML file can go in 2026.

items.title: Atlas Maps
items.content_text: An offline-first map viewer that serves your own tile sets from a static host, with vector labels, a mobile-friendly UI and service-worker caching for field trips.

items.title: CSV Wrangler
items.content_text: A command-line swiss knife for messy spreadsheets: streaming CSV parsing, type inference, dedupe and join, all in a single static binary with no runtime dependencies.

items.title: Ink Scheduler
items.content_text: A desktop timetable planner with handwriting input for stylus laptops, exporting clean PDF schedules; still an alpha experiment around time-blocking heuristics.
